prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Zinc (아연) itself — the sovereign of the Zinc Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: late twenties — a graceful grown-up face with soft, smooth contours; no wrinkles, folds or under-eye bags.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: zinc: blue-grey metal that guards iron by corroding first, a sacrificial shield that wears itself away into chalk-white zinc oxide; hot-dip galvanized steel blooming with crystalline frost-flower spangle; paired with copper it becomes golden brass; the zinc discs of Volta's first battery and of every zinc-carbon cell; a selfless guardian that wears down so others stay whole. Palette: blue-grey galvanized zinc with crystalline spangle, chalk zinc-oxide white, clear aqua, a touch of brass gold.

World (fixed): a guardian-order kingdom on a high mountain pass: a great iron gate shielded by blue-grey zinc-clad walls blooming with crystalline frost-flower spangle, a long wall of knights' spangled shields, a watchtower worn chalk-white where its zinc gave itself away to keep the iron from rust. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette; 2) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 3) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 4) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 5) plate armor under a long heraldic tabard with a white cape to the ankles — a straight, holy silhouette; 6) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 7) a long coat below the knees with epaulettes, a belt, gloves and tall boots — a crisp, commanding officer's silhouette; 8) dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): blue-grey galvanized zinc with crystalline spangle, chalk zinc-oxide white, clear aqua, a touch of brass gold.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): blue-grey hair with a crystalline galvanized-spangle sheen. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Zn) and atomic number (30) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Original design: Choose silhouette 7, a commanding officer's long coat below the knees with epaulettes, belt and tall boots, interpreted entirely in high-fantasy materials. A sleeveless deep-necked chalk-white coat has stiff zinc-clad lapels and an open front above short aqua underlayers; layered zinc shoulder vanes and coat-tail edges are detachable sacrificial armor segments, crystalline blue-grey surfaces worn white toward their tips. No modern machinery. Adult woman with light honey skin, a compact heart-shaped face and softly rounded chin, large amber eyes, poised confident smile, blue-grey hair in a high long ponytail with softly parted curtain bangs. Full-busted athletic-curvy build. Both bare human hands empty, relaxed and fully visible, five fingers each. Standing with balanced weight at the upper fortress battlement before a huge protective iron gate and distant snow peaks; bright clear daylight. One woman only.
